title: A/E Services for FY27 Lausche Facility Improvements
short_description: A/E services for assessment, design, and administration of major Lausche facility upgrades.
project_scope: Major facility upgrades, renovations, and repairs within the Lausche facility/building portfolio managed by the Ohio Department of Administrative Services. The process begins with a comprehensive facility condition assessment in FY26, followed by prioritized design and construction administration for approved works in the FY27/28 biennium. Total stated construction cost is 6.2 million USD.
services: Survey/assessment, architectural and engineering design, CMR bidding and procurement assistance, and construction administration; requested disciplines include architecture, civil, surveying/GIS/mapping, construction/project management, materials testing, environmental, electrical, fire protection, mechanical, structural, and utility engineering.
relevance_explanation:
- Building renovation/repair project with broad multidisciplinary A/E scope.
- Includes structural engineering, but no specific complex structural challenge is described.
- Appears to be general facility improvements rather than an architecturally demanding or long-span structure.
- Administrative/public building upgrade projects are generally of lower interest to sbp.
- Some strategic relevance due to early assessment and design involvement, but limited fit overall.
fee_explanation: No explicit design fee is stated in the source. Only total construction cost of 6.2 million USD and broad A/E services are provided.
references_qualifications: A/E firms are sought for multidisciplinary services including architecture, civil, surveying/GIS/mapping, construction/project management, materials testing, environmental, electrical, fire protection, mechanical, structural, and utility engineering. No specific minimum reference counts or qualification thresholds are stated in the source.
